Game Overview

Color Crowd is a action title where lead your lively Color Crowd through a vibrant maze, changing their hue to match obstacles. With a simple tap or swipe, navigate ever-evolving landscapes, dodge threats, and aim for a high score. Quick reflexes and color mastery are your keys to success in this thrilling, endlessly entertaining adventure.
